question: total area residential buildings km2
sql: SELECT SUM(ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry)) / 1e6 AS area_km2 FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE subtype = 'residential';

question: total length footways km
sql: SELECT SUM(ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry)) / 1000 AS length_km FROM lisbon_roads WHERE class = 'footway';

question: 5 largest buildings by footprint m2
sql: SELECT names.primary AS name, ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry) AS area_m2 FROM lisbon_buildings ORDER BY ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry) DESC LIMIT 5;

question: average height apartments metres
sql: SELECT AVG(height) AS avg_height_m FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE class = 'apartments';

question: road length by class km
sql: SELECT class, SUM(ST_Length_Spheroid(geometry)) / 1000 AS length_km FROM lisbon_roads GROUP BY class ORDER BY length_km DESC;

question: commercial flat roof buildings total area km2
sql: SELECT SUM(ST_Area_Spheroid(geometry)) / 1e6 AS area_km2 FROM lisbon_buildings WHERE subtype = 'commercial' AND roof_shape = 'flat';
